adaptations: Each original parameter expansion is an independent Rust #[test], documented with its exact frozen Python ID. Application assertions invoke native admission, conversion, command services, stores, HTTP routers, OS-backed locks, and atomic file operations.

Python reflective mutations that Rust typed fields cannot hold use the original malformed Value at complete-record admission and the real ProfileRepo::import_file write boundary. Where the model retains the malformed Value, the real ProfileRepo::save object door is also refused.

Failure snapshots compare exact bytes of every regular file, including temporary files and browser Cookies. Only native coordination lock files/directories (.locks, .transaction.lock, .lock) are excluded.

Python monkeypatch write/conversion/unlink/cleanup failures use feature-guarded thread-local observers at real native boundaries. Observer context crosses the actual HTTP blocking-task boundary and is restored by RAII; no process-global fault environment switches exist.

Eleven concurrency scenarios use native child test processes and local TCP rendezvous against one owned data root. They exercise the production OS lock implementation; other original thread races remain native thread races. Child environment variables configure only the native test rendezvous, never product fault behavior.

Python exceptions/capsys are native Result, io::Error, HTTP status/body, and command Outcome assertions. RollbackFailed retains and exposes the actual original cause, every failed path/error, and continued cleanup.

Python healthy-object allocation identity and UserDict class identity have no equivalent in the owned serde_json Value API; their native adaptations are explicitly recorded per case. Value integrity and non-mutation are verified.
Raw NaN/Infinity request and legacy-record cases preserve their original wire tokens, exercising native extended JSON parsing and named write refusal. Tests never invoke Python.
